title: Area-code shard C pass 32 — 821 / 830 / 839

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public organizational actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 821, 830, and 839?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public organizational-role enumeration, seed-family expansion, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay/locality-derived NPA hits, geographic association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: 821 overlays 864 in the Greenville/Upstate region. Reused canonical Upstate Food Not Bombs, GVL SC Mask Bloc, and USDA Mutual Aid Project with fresh current-status evidence. GVL SC Mask Bloc public communications expanded across Facebook, X, Reddit, Instagram and Bluesky.
Added Mutual Aid Resource Collective (MARC) in New Braunfels. Its own public hub explicitly states it is structured through social/collectivist anarchism and links @mutualaid_marc.

839 overlays 803 in Columbia. Reused canonical Columbia Food Not Bombs and PITCH 803. Current host evidence lists first-name-only public FNB contacts Maris and Judy; both remain source-scoped and are not merged with similarly named people.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-organizational-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public organizational-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 821, 830, and 839.
